note: Three finding dossiers. Every fact carries its own locator (file path + line number). No bird taxon, no bird claim id, no held-out data. Facts were read in the named files before this file was written.

tasks.one_line: The design scorer's composite has never beaten its own strongest single term on the primary ranking endpoint.

facts.text: Every number is from the blind held-out run of each scorer version: 168 held-out families, scored family-out.
v1.3.0 rank_score beats nearest-neighbour distance on endpoint P1: 0.875, difference +0.032, CI 0.026 to 0.040.
rank_score does NOT beat its own joint Mahalanobis term used alone on P1: difference -0.008, CI -0.020 to 0.002.
Over all held-out items the composite is significantly WORSE than the joint term alone: -0.007, CI -0.013 to -0.002.
The joint Mahalanobis term used alone reaches P1 0.883 and passes all three primary endpoints by itself.
The other components earn their place only on secondary endpoints S4 and S5, which the joint term alone fails.
The evaluation was run by an evaluator who built neither the scorer nor the benchmark; dev results count for nothing.

tasks.one_line: "Real organisms score plausible" carries almost no evidence that the design scorer works, because negatives score plausible too.

facts.text: 168 held-out families, scored family-out, in a blind held-out run of every scorer version.
On the plausibility score, 98 to 99.6 % of real held-out organisms score at or above the 0.5 cut in every version.
Only 12 to 17 % of negatives score below the same 0.5 cut.
Every version is therefore close to calling everything plausible; the share of real organisms scoring high carries almost no evidence that a scorer works.
Two families with at least 3 real items have fewer than 80 % of them scoring plausible: Eurypharyngidae (gulper eels, 3 of 5) and Aspredinidae (banjo catfishes, 20 of 29).
Example low scorer: fs-05942, a gulper eel, scores 0.15; its nearest remaining neighbour once its family is removed is the cutlassfish Lepturacanthus savala at distance 0.96.

tasks.one_line: On the winged-zebrafish headline run the design scorer's composite is 0.878 and "plausible" while two of the five named gates FAIL and two cannot be assessed, and the validator withholds the word "validated".

facts.text: validate_generation on generated=winged-zebrafish, base=zebrafish-adult, desired phenotype "a zebrafish that glides at least 5 m from a 1 m launch and survives 10-30 C as an adult": phenotype_similarity pass; functional_resolution fail; physics_check fail; genotype_similarity cannot-assess; lean_check cannot-assess.
The scorer's own composite on the same run is 0.878, flagged plausible true, version 1.0.0, carried through for reference and explicitly not the report's verdict; no gate feeds it.
withheld_because: 2 gate(s) failed; 2 gate(s) could not be assessed; 3 biological scale(s) could not be assessed; no sequence was compared at any locus.
The CLI exit code is 0 when every gate passed, 1 when any gate failed, 2 when nothing failed but something could not be assessed; this run exited 1.
